title: Generic Future Inextendibility with Square-Integrable Connection Near a Fixed Kerr Spacetime

issues.location: sections/nonlinear_comparison.tex, Prop. dn-low-error (quadratic low error) and Lemma dn-high-uniform
issues.description: The quadratic L^2 energy estimate for actual-minus-template (bound amp^2 e^{eta_2 T}) is the analytic core of the deep comparison at amplitude e^{-kappa T/4} > sqrt(a). It is presented as a cost bookkeeping (lapse-compensated Hodge losses, triangular interaction graph (Y,N,z,D_b)->P, bad-strip length nu T/2) that is internally consistent but too compressed to verify every source placement line by line. I found no specific failing step.
issues.evidence: The checked placements are consistent: the bound |Delta xi|_1 <= C(sigma^{-1}Z+P) only ever enters multiplied by a' or sigma*h (dn:compensation); the shift equation picks up a factor q; the P currents have no reverse arrow, so a small multiplier delta_P closes the estimate. Interpolation with the e^{o(T)} high bounds then gives e^{-(1+c)alpha T} = o(amp), which is consistent with (dn:interpolation-choice).

issues.location: sections/holonomy_category.tex, Prop. averaged-holonomy and Thm. nowhere-dense
issues.description: Checked the averaged holonomy obstruction and found it correct. This entry records what was verified; it is not a defect.
issues.evidence: dx <= C r^{-1} dvol_g follows from sqrt|det g_coord| = r sqrt|det G|. Markov with R_T = r^{-17/32} gives an exceptional set of size C r^{1/16}. Loop holonomy is at most C l_T r^{15/32}. The 18-node Vandermonde extraction gives |C_2| <= C l_T^{-2} r^{15/32} l_T + Q_T l_T^{16} = C r^{13/32} + Q_T r = o(r^{1/4}). Base-frame bounds (K(G,U) = G + 2(GU)(GU)^T, det K = -det G) and the stop argument hold. Measure count: .95 - .04 = .91 per slice, and |I_T| > |J_0|/2 gives positive joint measure (.455), which beats the vanishing exceptional sets.

coverage: Read in full: introduction, weak_exits (homotopy lemma, first-exit graph, box averaging, positive exit family, exit tests, countable cover), attachment_signal (attachment, curvature signal formula and leading amp*lambda^2 term, matched seeds, Gram block and volume density), holonomy_category (loop jets, averaged holonomy, nowhere-denseness, main theorem). Read the statement, setup and last third of nonlinear_comparison (quadratic low error, interpolation, continuation) and the statement of packet_preparation. Checked all exponent arithmetic of the holonomy scales by hand. Not checked in detail: background.tex (branch tube, runout), the packet construction proofs, the uniform high-bounds lemma, or companion inputs (C2/C1 companions for classification, corner nullity, attachment).
main_claim: For each fixed Kerr background with M>0 and 0<|a|<M, the smooth vacuum data in a p_10-small weighted neighborhood of the two-ended bridge whose MGHD admits a future C^0 ∩ W^{1,2}_loc extension form a meagre set.
sibling_notes: Family 264 siblings (C2 and C1 companions) both reported no_gap_found. This paper uses their intermediate results (finite-lifetime classification, corner nullity, attachment interface, Baire property, interpolation lemma), not their headline theorems, so there is no circularity. The new ingredients (exit family at L^2 regularity, deep comparison at amp = e^{-kappa T/4}, averaged holonomy) check out at the level verified.
